explanation: Use Parent links to measure both depths. Raise the deeper node until depths agree, then move both parents together until their references match. The wrapper locates the two target Data values.
timeComplexity: O(h) ancestor computation; O(n) with wrapper lookup
spaceComplexity: O(1) ancestor state; O(h) wrapper lookup recursion
